conditions: Quality profiles subscribe to authoritative events but do not redefine them.
Critical information has a cheaper validated representation before its expensive layer is removed.
Replay compares authoritative checkpoints across profiles.
effect: Supported hardware can reduce presentation cost without changing mechanics, timing contracts, earned state, or the next decision.
failure_boundary: A quality or performance mode that changes hidden simulation, removes a required cue, or produces a different checkpoint is a distinct game configuration and cannot claim graceful degradation.
